_comment: Schema of deployments/timelock-roles.<ENV>.json — the committed expected-holder manifest of the GOV-1
48h TimelockController that owns SuperPaymaster and Registry after runbook M1 (spec 03 §10.7b GOV-1/2).
Create the real file for a network when its timelock is deployed (A5s on Sepolia, A6 on OP mainnet) and
update it only through a reviewed change. Both checks read it:
- UpgradeViaTimelock.m1Preflight (forge, bounded): hasRole for the timelock, the Safe and every address
listed here; reverts if the file is missing or `timelock` differs from the configured timelock;
- script/governance/check-timelock-roles.mjs (event history): rebuilds the FULL holder set of every
role from RoleGranted/RoleRevoked since `deploymentBlock` and fails unless it equals `roles` exactly.
`roles` must be the M1 policy: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = [timelock] only; PROPOSER/CANCELLER/EXECUTOR = [Safe]
only (Mycelium Safe 0x51eDf11fDb0A4F66220eFb8efA54Eca77232E114 on live chains; no open executor).
`mustHoldNothing` = HISTORICAL accounts persisted here (deployer, old SP owner, old Registry owner, any
other known EOA), never derived from the proxies' current owner().
